content.short: Raid Guild is a DAO project organizing a fellowship of builders, designers, and hustlers to advance the future of work through collaboration and resources.
content.description: Raid Guild believes DAOs will power the future of work. By connecting a fellowship of builders, designers, and hustlers through the MetaCartel network, they strive to turn this future into reality. They share resources, branding, and collaboration tools to create value for the Ethereum ecosystem. Profits from their work fund open-source tooling and public goods, and they openly share their learnings and processes with the community to help others learn and build. This approach also accelerates open-source development and broad knowledge sharing across the space.
